title: Saperim - Weapon Stats & Location (Expedition 33)
description: Saperim in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - which character uses it, its element and scaling, and exactly where to get it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Saperim is a lightning-element weapon used by Lune. It scales with Defense (B), Luck (C).

sections.title: Is the Saperim Worth Using?
sections.content: Scales off Defense (B), Luck (C). A dedicated lightning pick - it belongs in a build already committed to that element.
